 APC Policy Schedule
 As a non-profit, volunteer-led academic journal, GRHAS maintains a transparent Article Processing Charge (APC) policy. These fees support digital infrastructure, peer review coordination, typesetting, DOI registration, and long-term archiving.
 1. Article Processing Charges (APC)
 Effective May 1, 2026 , the APC for all standard research publishing articles is USD 450 .
 Standard Research Publishing 
 (Includes DOI Registration & Permanent Indexing) 
 Article Type 
 Original Articles (OA)
 Theoretical Explorations (TE)
 Case Studies (CS)
 Methods & Tools (MT)
 Art Practices & Reflections (AP)
 Scholarly Exchange & Reviews 
 (Fee-Exempt / No DOI Assignment*) 
 Book Reviews (BR) / Interviews & Dialogues (ID)
 Free
 Perspectives & Commentaries (PC) / Conference Reports (CR)
 Free
 Thematic Introductions (TI)
 Free (Invited)
 * IMPORTANT DOI POLICY: Articles in the fee-exempt category are published for academic exchange and may be published without a Digital Object Identifier (DOI), in accordance with the journal’s editorial policy.
 2. Waiver Policy
 Waivers are available for authors without institutional support or from low-income economies. Requests must be submitted at the time of submission .
 ↓ Download Waiver Form Contact Editorial Office 
 3. Payment Logistics
 Fees are charged only upon final acceptance of the manuscript. 
 Supported payment methods: PayPal, Stripe, or International Bank Transfer. 
 Multimedia: Up to five figures/tables are included. Complex datasets or high-resolution artistic galleries may incur additional production fees. 
 4. Transitional Rule
 Manuscripts submitted before May 1, 2026 will follow the APC policy in effect on the date of submission .
 Legal & Financial Disclaimer
 GRHAS is a non-profit, volunteer-led scholarly initiative. All APCs are directly reinvested into the journal’s operational costs.
 Inquiries: [email protected]

 Waiver Policy
 Fostering Global Academic Equity and Inclusion
 Equity & Inclusion Statement
 To support early-career researchers and ensure that financial barriers do not impede the dissemination of high-quality scholarship, GRHAS offers discretionary fee waivers or reductions. These reflect our non-commercial, volunteer-led model and are granted upon rigorous editorial review.
 1.1 Young Scholar Support
 Who is Eligible?
 Undergraduate, Master’s, or Doctoral students 
 Postdocs (within 5 years of PhD completion) 
 Authors under the age of 35 
 First-time authors in international journals 
 Support Offered
 30–50% reduction or full APC waiver 
 No fixed quota ; all applications reviewed fairly 
 Additional Career Benefits: GRHAS official recommendation letters & priority invitation to reviewer training programs. 
 1.2 Low-Income Economies
 Eligibility Criteria
 Authors affiliated with institutions in countries listed as "Low-income" or "Lower-middle-income" by the World Bank.
 → Reference: World Bank Country Classifications 
 Support Offered
 30–100% reduction based on financial need 
 Automatic priority for work aligned with UN SDGs 
 Support for non-native English language polishing 
 1.3 Application Process
 Waiver requests are evaluated by the GRHAS Financial Coordination Team independently of the peer-review process. Please note that standard APC levels apply unless a formal waiver is approved.
 ↓ Download Waiver Request Form * Submit during initial submission or prior to peer review. 
 Questions? Contact the GRHAS Editorial Office:
 [email protected]

 Fee-exempt categories remain unchanged, including BR, ID, PC, CR, and invited TI contributions.
 Manuscripts submitted before May 1, 2026 will follow the APC policy in effect on the date of submission.

 APC & Waiver Policy
 Standard Article Processing Charges APC
 AI and Future Society is an open-access journal. To support high-quality peer review professional editing and digital archiving the following fees apply:
 Research Articles USD 300
 Commentaries and Perspectives Free
 Invited or Special Issue Articles Discounted or waived by prior agreement
 APCs are invoiced only after acceptance. 
 Waiver and Discount Policy
 To promote equitable access APC waivers or discounts are available for authors with limited funding. Waiver decisions are made independently of the peer review process.
 Full waivers are granted to:
 Authors from low or lower-middle income countries per World Bank
 Graduate students or independent researchers without institutional funding
 Research primarily conducted in the Global South
 Partial waivers may be considered for:
 Authors from middle-income countries
 Social science or interdisciplinary work with limited funding
 Editor-recommended outstanding submissions
 How to Apply
 Indicate waiver request at submission with a short statement on funding
 Optional include a letter from your institution or supervisor
 Waiver decisions are made prior to acceptance and do not influence peer review

 Call for Papers: Vol. 2, No. 1 (May 2026) | No APC This Issue 
 Call for Papers: Vol. 2, No. 1 (May 2026) | No APC This Issue
 Posted on 2025-12-02 06:31:07
 Dear authors and researchers,
 AI & Future Society (ISSN: 3053-4011) is now accepting submissions for Volume 2, Issue 1 (May 2026) .
 Submission deadline: April 15, 2026 
 This is a regular issue of the journal.
There are no Article Processing Charges (APC) for this issue.
Editorial theme for this issue
 The editorial theme of Volume 2, Issue 1 (May 2026) is:
 AI, Algorithmic Thresholds, and Social Fairness:
AI Systems, Social Theory, Ethics, Economics, and Public Policy Governance in the Context of the U.S. Middle-Class “Cut-Off Line” Debate 
 In recent years, AI-driven decision systems have increasingly relied on algorithmic thresholds, scoring mechanisms, and cut-off points in areas such as social welfare, healthcare, credit evaluation, education access, taxation, and housing policy.
 Public debates—particularly in the United States—have highlighted how these threshold-based systems may contribute to the structural exclusion of middle-income and near-threshold populations , often described in public discourse as a “middle-class cut-off line.”
 This issue encourages submissions that critically examine:
 AI-driven threshold and scoring systems as socio-technical arrangements
 The interaction between algorithmic decision-making and social stratification
 Ethical issues related to fairness, responsibility, and accountability
 Economic rationales embedded in algorithmic governance
 Public policy and regulatory responses to AI-mediated exclusion
 Contributions may draw on social theory, ethics, economics, public policy, law, or interdisciplinary approaches .
Scope and sections
 As a regular open-topic issue , submissions are welcome on the above theme as well as on other topics , provided they align with one of the journal’s core sections:
 Peer-reviewed research sections: 
 AI & Ethics (AIE)
 AI Governance & Regulation (GOV)
 Human–AI Interaction (HAI)
 Technology & Future Society (TFS)
 Critical AI Studies (CAS)
 AI in Medicine & Health (AIMH)
 Non–peer-reviewed section: 
 Perspectives & Commentary (COM)
Important notes
 This is not a special issue .
 Manuscripts related to the editorial theme are particularly encouraged, but other relevant submissions are also welcome .
 All submissions undergo initial editorial screening and, where applicable, double-blind peer review.
Submission system
 Please submit your manuscript via the journal’s online submission system :
 https://grhas.centraluniteduniversity.de/index.php/AFS 
 We look forward to your contributions.

 Article Processing Charges (APC)
 Open Access & Fees
 Article Processing Charges (APC)
 文章处理费（APC）
 The Journal of Law, Psychology, and Communication Studies (JLPCS) is a fully open access academic journal. To support editorial processing, peer review administration, digital production, online hosting, DOI registration, and long-term journal maintenance, an Article Processing Charge is applied only to manuscripts formally accepted for publication.
 《法律·心理学·传播研究学刊》（JLPCS）为开放获取学术期刊。为支持编辑处理、同行评议管理、数字出版制作、在线托管、DOI 注册和长期期刊维护，本刊仅对正式录用的稿件收取文章处理费。
 USD 275 APC
 Approx. RMB 2,000
 10% Handling Charge
 No Submission Fee
 Payable After Acceptance
 1. APC Overview / APC 概览
 Standard APC 
 USD 275 per accepted article, equivalent to approximately RMB 2,000 . 
每篇正式录用文章的标准 APC 为 275 美元 ，约合 人民币 2,000 元 。
 Payment Processing / Bank Transfer Handling Charge 
 A 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge is applied at the payment stage. 
付款或转账阶段将收取 10% 的支付处理或银行转账手续费 。
 Estimated Total Payable 
 USD 275 + 10% handling charge = USD 302.50 
or approximately 
 RMB 2,000 + 10% handling charge = RMB 2,200 . 
Final payable amount is subject to the official payment notice or invoice issued by the JLPCS Editorial Office. 
最终应付金额以 JLPCS 编辑部正式发出的付款通知或发票为准。
 Submission Fee 
 No submission fee is charged. 
本刊 不收取投稿费 。
 Peer Review Fee 
 No peer review fee is charged. 
本刊 不收取审稿费 。
 When Payable 
 APC and applicable payment handling charges are payable only after a manuscript has successfully completed editorial evaluation and has been formally accepted for publication. 
APC 及适用支付手续费仅在稿件完成编辑评估并被正式录用后支付。
 Important Payment Note / 重要付款说明
 A 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge is applied when the APC is paid. This charge is collected only after formal acceptance and does not constitute a submission fee or peer review fee.
 APC 支付时将收取 10% 的支付处理或银行转账手续费。该费用仅在稿件正式录用后付款时产生，不属于投稿费或审稿费。
 2. Purpose of the APC / APC 用途
 The APC supports the operational and publication costs associated with maintaining a fully open access academic journal.
 The APC contributes to: 
 Editorial management and manuscript administration;
 Peer review coordination and reviewer communication;
 Copyediting, proofreading, typesetting, and digital production;
 Online publication, journal platform support, and long-term website maintenance;
 DOI registration, metadata preparation, and article-level publication records;
 Open access dissemination and journal operations.
 APC 用于支持开放获取期刊运行，包括编辑管理、同行评议协调、文字编辑、校对、排版、数字出版、在线托管、平台维护、DOI 注册、元数据准备和开放获取传播。
 3. Payment Handling Charge / 支付处理或银行转账手续费
 In addition to the APC, a 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge is applied at the payment stage. This handling charge covers transaction, remittance, payment platform, banking, currency conversion, and administrative processing costs associated with APC payment.
 The handling charge is calculated as 10% of the APC amount;
 For USD payment, the estimated total is USD 302.50;
 For RMB payment, the estimated total is RMB 2,200;
 The exact payable amount will be stated in the official invoice or payment instruction;
 Additional charges imposed by the payer’s bank, intermediary bank, payment provider, or currency conversion service may be borne by the payer where applicable;
 The handling charge does not affect editorial evaluation or publication decisions.
 10% 手续费用于覆盖 APC 支付过程中产生的交易、汇款、支付平台、银行、币种转换及行政处理成本。最终金额以编辑部发出的正式付款说明或发票为准。
 4. When Authors Are Charged / 收费时间
 JLPCS does not charge any fee at submission, during editorial screening, or during peer review. The APC and applicable payment handling charge become payable only after formal acceptance.
 Stage 1
 Submission / 投稿
 No fee is charged at submission.
 Stage 2
 Peer Review / 同行评议
 No peer review fee is charged.
 Stage 3
 Formal Acceptance / 正式录用
 APC and applicable handling charge become payable after formal acceptance.
 Stage 4
 Production / 出版制作
 Payment confirmation may be required before final production or publication.
 投稿、初审和同行评议阶段不收取任何费用。只有在稿件正式录用后，作者才需要根据付款通知支付 APC 及适用手续费。
 5. Invoicing and Receipt / 发票与收据
 Following formal acceptance, the JLPCS Editorial Office will issue payment instructions or an invoice indicating the APC, applicable handling charge, payment method, currency, payment deadline, and total amount payable.
 The invoice or payment notice will state the APC amount;
 The 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge will be shown separately where applicable;
 The total payable amount will be clearly indicated;
 Payment instructions will be provided by the editorial office;
 A payment confirmation or receipt may be provided after the transaction is completed;
 Authors should not make payment before receiving official payment instructions from the JLPCS Editorial Office.
 稿件正式录用后，JLPCS 编辑部将发出付款说明或发票，列明 APC、10% 手续费、付款方式、币种、付款期限和应付总额。作者不应在收到正式付款说明前自行付款。
 6. Waiver Policy / 费用减免政策
 Authors facing genuine financial constraints may submit a request for a full or partial APC waiver. Waiver requests are considered individually and independently of the editorial review process.
 A waiver request should normally include: 
 Manuscript title and submission ID;
 Corresponding author name and contact information;
 A brief explanation of the financial hardship or funding limitation;
 Institutional, grant, or funding information where relevant;
 Requested type of support, such as full waiver or partial waiver;
 Any supporting documentation that the authors wish to provide.
 经济困难作者可申请全额或部分 APC 减免。费用减免申请将独立于编辑审查和同行评议流程处理，不影响稿件的学术评估或录用决定。
 7. Editorial Independence / 编辑独立性
 APC payment, payment handling charges, waiver requests, payment capacity, institutional background, funding source, or author nationality must not influence editorial decisions.
 APC is not considered during editorial screening;
 APC is not considered during peer review;
 APC is not considered when selecting reviewers;
 APC is not considered when issuing revision decisions;
 APC is not considered when making acceptance or rejection decisions;
 APC or waiver status does not affect publication ethics or research integrity decisions.
 APC、支付手续费、费用减免申请、作者支付能力、机构背景、资助来源或国籍不得影响编辑初审、同行评议、审稿人选择、修改决定、录用决定、拒稿决定或出版伦理处理。
 8. What the APC Does Not Cover / APC 不包括的事项
 The APC supports journal publication operations. It does not purchase editorial acceptance, favorable review, expedited acceptance, special treatment, or exemption from journal policies.
 APC does not guarantee acceptance;
 APC does not guarantee favorable peer review;
 APC does not exempt authors from revision requirements;
 APC does not exempt authors from publication ethics, originality, data integrity, authorship, or copyright requirements;
 APC does not cover optional third-party services independently arranged

 APC & Waiver Policy
 Open Access & Fees
 APC & Waiver Policy
 文章处理费与费用减免政策
 The Journal of Law, Psychology, and Communication Studies (JLPCS) maintains a modest Article Processing Charge to support open access publication. APC waivers are reserved for authors experiencing genuine and serious financial hardship.
 《法律·心理学·传播研究学刊》（JLPCS）以较低的文章处理费支持开放获取出版。费用减免主要面向确有真实且严重经济困难的作者。
 Modest APC
 Genuine Hardship Only
 Full or Partial Waiver
 Independent of Review
 No Submission Fee
 1. Purpose of the Policy / 政策目的
 This policy explains JLPCS’s Article Processing Charge, payment timing, payment handling charge, waiver eligibility, waiver request procedure, review criteria, confidentiality, and editorial independence safeguards.
 JLPCS keeps its APC at a modest level to support accessibility for authors while sustaining open access publication operations. Because the APC is already set low, waivers are limited and are intended for authors who genuinely cannot pay due to serious financial hardship.
 本政策说明 JLPCS 关于文章处理费、付款时间、支付手续费、减免资格、申请流程、审核标准、保密处理和编辑独立性的规定。由于 JLPCS 的 APC 已保持在较低水平，费用减免资源有限，主要用于帮助确因严重经济困难而无法承担费用的作者。
 2. Standard APC / 标准文章处理费
 Standard APC 
 USD 275 per accepted article, equivalent to approximately RMB 2,000 . 
每篇正式录用文章的标准 APC 为 275 美元 ，约合 人民币 2,000 元 。
 Payment Handling Charge 
 A 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge is applied at the payment stage. 
付款或转账阶段将收取 10% 的支付处理或银行转账手续费 。
 Estimated Total Payable 
 USD 302.50 or approximately RMB 2,200 , unless a waiver or partial waiver has been approved. 
如未获减免，预计应付金额为 302.50 美元 或约 人民币 2,200 元 。
 Submission and Review Fees 
 JLPCS does not charge submission fees or peer review fees. 
JLPCS 不收取投稿费或审稿费。
 When Payable 
 APC and applicable handling charges are payable only after formal acceptance. 
APC 及适用手续费仅在稿件正式录用后支付。
 3. General Waiver Principle / 减免基本原则
 JLPCS may consider full or partial APC waivers for authors facing genuine and serious financial hardship. Waivers are not automatic, not guaranteed, and not intended as a general discount mechanism.
 Waiver requests are considered individually;
 Waiver resources are limited;
 Full waivers are exceptional and reserved for severe hardship cases;
 Partial waivers may be offered where authors can contribute part of the APC;
 Waiver decisions are independent of editorial decisions;
 Waiver requests must not be used to influence peer review or acceptance.
 JLPCS 可为确有真实且严重经济困难的作者考虑全额或部分 APC 减免。费用减免并非自动授予，也不是常规折扣机制。全额减免通常仅适用于特别困难情况。
 4. Who May Be Eligible / 可能符合条件的情况
 Waivers are intended for authors who have no realistic access to institutional, grant, departmental, project, employer, sponsor, or personal funds for publication charges.
 Eligible hardship situations may include: 
 Authors with no institutional support, no grant funding, and no publication budget;
 Independent researchers without stable income or research funding;
 Students or early-career researchers facing serious financial hardship and lacking institutional support;
 Researchers from resource-limited institutions where publication funding is not available;
 Authors experiencing unemployment, displacement, serious illness, family hardship, or other exceptional financial difficulty;
 Authors whose research is academically suitable for JLPCS but who genuinely cannot pay even the modest APC.
 减免主要面向确无机构、课题、院系、雇主、资助方或个人资金来源的作者。申请人应说明为什么无法承担已较低的 APC，而不仅仅是希望降低出版成本。
 5. Situations Not Normally Sufficient / 通常不足以支持减免的情况
 Because JLPCS maintains a low APC, waiver requests should be based on genuine inability to pay, not convenience, preference, or general cost-saving.
 The following are not normally sufficient on their own: 
 Preference not to use available institutional or grant funds;
 General statement that APCs are inconvenient or undesirable;
 Delay in institutional reimbursement when payment can still be arranged;
 Request for discount after payment has already been made;
 Request based only on manuscript quality, seniority, title, affiliation, or publication urgency;
 Availability of other funding sources that could reasonably cover the APC;
 Use of paid editing, formatting, submission agency, or third-party publication services while claiming inability to pay the APC.
 仅因“不想支付”“希望节省成本”“机构报销慢”或“文章质量较高”提出减免，通常不足以支持申请。减免应基于真实经济困难，而非一般性费用偏好。
 6. Full Waiver and Partial Waiver / 全额减免与部分减免
 Type 
 Description 
 Full Waiver 
全额减免
 A full APC waiver may be granted only in exceptional cases of severe financial hardship. If a full waiver is approved, no APC payment is required. Normally, no 10% payment handling charge applies when no APC payment is made.
 Partial Waiver 
部分减免
 A partial waiver reduces the payable APC amount. The 10% payment handling charge is normally calculated on the reduced payable amount unless otherwise stated in the invoice.
 No Waiver 
不予减免
 If a waiver is not approved, the standard APC and applicable 10% handling charge remain payable after formal acceptance.
 减免类型由编辑部根据申请材料、经济困难程度和可用减免资源决定。最终应付金额以正式付款通知或发票为准。
 7. When to Request a Waiver / 何时申请减免
 Authors who believe they may need APC support should contact the JLPCS Editorial Office as early as possible, preferably at submission or before formal acceptance. Late waiver requests may be difficult to accommodate.
 Authors may indicate potential financial hardship at submission;
 Waiver requests may also be submitted during revision or before final acceptance;
 Requests should be submitted before payment is made;
 Requests submitted after invoice issuance may still be considered, but are not guaranteed;
 Requests submitted after payment has been completed are normally not considered for refund;
 Authors should not delay revision or proof correction while waiting for informal fee discussions.
 有减免需求的作者应尽早联系编辑部，最好在投稿时或正式录用前提出。付款完成后再申请减免，通常不予退款处理。
 8. How to Submit a Waiver Request / 如何提交减免申请
 Waiver requests should be submitted in writing to the JLPCS Editorial Office. The request should be concise, truthful, and supported by relevant information.
 A waiver request should normally include: 
 Manuscript title and submission ID, if available;
 Corresponding author name, affiliation, country or region, and contact email;
 Requested support: full waiver or partial waiver;
 Brief explanation of serious financial hardship;
 Statement confirming whether institutional, grant, departmental, employer, sponsor, or project funds are available;
 Information about student, independent researcher, unemployed, unfunded, or resource-limited status where applicable;
 Any supporting document the author wishes to provide;
 Confirmation that the waiver request is truthful and complete.
 申请材料应真实、简明、具体。作者不必披露过度私人信息，但应提供足以说明“确实无法承担费用”的基本情况。

 Article Processing Charges (APC)
 文章处理费（APC）
 The Journal of Law, Psychology, and Communication Studies (JLPCS) is a fully open access academic journal. To support editorial processing, peer review administration, digital production, online hosting, DOI registration, and long-term journal maintenance, an Article Processing Charge is applied only to manuscripts formally accepted for publication.
 《法律·心理学·传播研究学刊》（JLPCS）为开放获取学术期刊。为支持编辑处理、同行评议管理、数字出版制作、在线托管、DOI 注册和长期期刊维护，本刊仅对正式录用的稿件收取文章处理费。
 USD 275 APC
 Approx. RMB 2,000
 10% Handling Charge
 No Submission Fee
 Payable After Acceptance
 1. APC Overview / APC 概览
 Standard APC 
 USD 275 per accepted article, equivalent to approximately RMB 2,000 . 
每篇正式录用文章的标准 APC 为 275 美元 ，约合 人民币 2,000 元 。
 Payment Processing / Bank Transfer Handling Charge 
 A 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge is applied at the payment stage. 
付款或转账阶段将收取 10% 的支付处理或银行转账手续费 。
 Estimated Total Payable 
 USD 275 + 10% handling charge = USD 302.50 
or approximately 
 RMB 2,000 + 10% handling charge = RMB 2,200 . 
Final payable amount is subject to the official payment notice or invoice issued by the JLPCS Editorial Office. 
最终应付金额以 JLPCS 编辑部正式发出的付款通知或发票为准。
 Submission Fee 
 No submission fee is charged. 
本刊 不收取投稿费 。
 Peer Review Fee 
 No peer review fee is charged. 
本刊 不收取审稿费 。
 When Payable 
 APC and applicable payment handling charges are payable only after a manuscript has successfully completed editorial evaluation and has been formally accepted for publication. 
APC 及适用支付手续费仅在稿件完成编辑评估并被正式录用后支付。
 Important Payment Note / 重要付款说明
 A 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge is applied when the APC is paid. This charge is collected only after formal acceptance and does not constitute a submission fee or peer review fee.
 APC 支付时将收取 10% 的支付处理或银行转账手续费。该费用仅在稿件正式录用后付款时产生，不属于投稿费或审稿费。
 2. Purpose of the APC / APC 用途
 The APC supports the operational and publication costs associated with maintaining a fully open access academic journal.
 The APC contributes to: 
 Editorial management and manuscript administration;
 Peer review coordination and reviewer communication;
 Copyediting, proofreading, typesetting, and digital production;
 Online publication, journal platform support, and long-term website maintenance;
 DOI registration, metadata preparation, and article-level publication records;
 Open access dissemination and journal operations.
 APC 用于支持开放获取期刊运行，包括编辑管理、同行评议协调、文字编辑、校对、排版、数字出版、在线托管、平台维护、DOI 注册、元数据准备和开放获取传播。
 3. Payment Handling Charge / 支付处理或银行转账手续费
 In addition to the APC, a 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge is applied at the payment stage. This handling charge covers transaction, remittance, payment platform, banking, currency conversion, and administrative processing costs associated with APC payment.
 The handling charge is calculated as 10% of the APC amount;
 For USD payment, the estimated total is USD 302.50;
 For RMB payment, the estimated total is RMB 2,200;
 The exact payable amount will be stated in the official invoice or payment instruction;
 Additional charges imposed by the payer’s bank, intermediary bank, payment provider, or currency conversion service may be borne by the payer where applicable;
 The handling charge does not affect editorial evaluation or publication decisions.
 10% 手续费用于覆盖 APC 支付过程中产生的交易、汇款、支付平台、银行、币种转换及行政处理成本。最终金额以编辑部发出的正式付款说明或发票为准。
 4. When Authors Are Charged / 收费时间
 JLPCS does not charge any fee at submission, during editorial screening, or during peer review. The APC and applicable payment handling charge become payable only after formal acceptance.
 Stage 1
 Submission / 投稿
 No fee is charged at submission.
 Stage 2
 Peer Review / 同行评议
 No peer review fee is charged.
 Stage 3
 Formal Acceptance / 正式录用
 APC and applicable handling charge become payable after formal acceptance.
 Stage 4
 Production / 出版制作
 Payment confirmation may be required before final production or publication.
 投稿、初审和同行评议阶段不收取任何费用。只有在稿件正式录用后，作者才需要根据付款通知支付 APC 及适用手续费。
 5. Invoicing and Receipt / 发票与收据
 Following formal acceptance, the JLPCS Editorial Office will issue payment instructions or an invoice indicating the APC, applicable handling charge, payment method, currency, payment deadline, and total amount payable.
 The invoice or payment notice will state the APC amount;
 The 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge will be shown separately where applicable;
 The total payable amount will be clearly indicated;
 Payment instructions will be provided by the editorial office;
 A payment confirmation or receipt may be provided after the transaction is completed;
 Authors should not make payment before receiving official payment instructions from the JLPCS Editorial Office.
 稿件正式录用后，JLPCS 编辑部将发出付款说明或发票，列明 APC、10% 手续费、付款方式、币种、付款期限和应付总额。作者不应在收到正式付款说明前自行付款。
 6. Waiver Policy / 费用减免政策
 Authors facing genuine financial constraints may submit a request for a full or partial APC waiver. Waiver requests are considered individually and independently of the editorial review process.
 A waiver request should normally include: 
 Manuscript title and submission ID;
 Corresponding author name and contact information;
 A brief explanation of the financial hardship or funding limitation;
 Institutional, grant, or funding information where relevant;
 Requested type of support, such as full waiver or partial waiver;
 Any supporting documentation that the authors wish to provide.
 经济困难作者可申请全额或部分 APC 减免。费用减免申请将独立于编辑审查和同行评议流程处理，不影响稿件的学术评估或录用决定。
 7. Editorial Independence / 编辑独立性
 APC payment, payment handling charges, waiver requests, payment capacity, institutional background, funding source, or author nationality must not influence editorial decisions.
 APC is not considered during editorial screening;
 APC is not considered during peer review;
 APC is not considered when selecting reviewers;
 APC is not considered when issuing revision decisions;
 APC is not considered when making acceptance or rejection decisions;
 APC or waiver status does not affect publication ethics or research integrity decisions.
 APC、支付手续费、费用减免申请、作者支付能力、机构背景、资助来源或国籍不得影响编辑初审、同行评议、审稿人选择、修改决定、录用决定、拒稿决定或出版伦理处理。
 8. What the APC Does Not Cover / APC 不包括的事项
 The APC supports journal publication operations. It does not purchase editorial acceptance, favorable review, expedited acceptance, special treatment, or exemption from journal policies.
 APC does not guarantee acceptance;
 APC does not guarantee favorable peer review;
 APC does not exempt authors from revision requirements;
 APC does not exempt authors from publication ethics, originality, data integrity, authorship, or copyright requirements;
 APC does not cover optional third-party services independently arranged

The APC and applicable payment handling charge become payable only after formal acceptance. /  Stage 1 /  Submission / 投稿 /  No fee is charged at submission. /  Stage 2 /  Peer Review / 同行评议 /  No peer review fee is charged. /  Stage 3 /  Formal Acceptance / 正式录用 /  APC and applicable handling charge become payable after formal acceptance. /  Stage 4 /  Production / 出版制作 /  Payment confirmation may be required before final production or publication. /  投稿、初审和同行评议阶段不收取任何费用。只有在稿件正式录用后，作者才需要根据付款通知支付 APC 及适用手续费。 /  5. Invoicing and Receipt / 发票与收据 /  Following formal acceptance, the JLPCS Editorial Office will issue payment instructions or an invoice indicating the APC, applicable handling charge, payment method, currency, payment deadline, and total amount payable. /  The invoice or payment notice will state the APC amount; /  The 10% payment processing or bank transfer handling charge will be shown separately where applicable; /  The total payable amount will be clearly indicated; /  Payment instructions will be provided by the editorial office; /  A payment confirmation or receipt may be provided after the transaction is completed; /  Authors should not make payment before receiving official payment instructions from the JLPCS Editorial Office. /  稿件正式录用后，JLPCS 编辑部将发出付款说明或发票，列明 APC、10% 手续费、付款方式、币种、付款期限和应付总额。作者不应在收到正式付款说明前自行付款。 /  6. Waiver Policy / 费用减免政策 /  Authors facing genuine financial constraints may submit a request for a full or partial APC waiver. Waiver requests are considered individually and independently of the editorial review process. /  A waiver request should normally include:  /  Manuscript title and submission ID; /  Corresponding author name and contact information; /  A brief explanation of the financial hardship or funding limitation; /  Institutional, grant, or funding information where relevant; /  Requested type of support, such as full waiver or partial waiver; /  Any supporting documentation that the authors wish to provide. /  经济困难作者可申请全额或部分 APC 减免。费用减免申请将独立于编辑审查和同行评议流程处理，不影响稿件的学术评估或录用决定。 /  7. Editorial Independence / 编辑独立性 /  APC payment, payment handling charges, waiver requests, payment capacity, institutional background, funding source, or author nationality must not influence editorial decisions. /  APC is not considered during editorial screening; /  APC is not considered during peer review; /  APC is not considered when selecting reviewers; /  APC is not considered when issuing revision decisions; /  APC is not considered when making acceptance or rejection decisions; /  APC or waiver status does not affect publication ethics or research integrity decisions. /  APC、支付手续费、费用减免申请、作者支付能力、机构背景、资助来源或国籍不得影响编辑初审、同行评议、审稿人选择、修改决定、录用决定、拒稿决定或出版伦理处理。 /  8. What the APC Does Not Cover / APC 不包括的事项 /  The APC supports journal publication operations. It does not purchase editorial acceptance, favorable review, expedited acceptance, special treatment, or exemption from journal policies. /  APC does not guarantee acceptance; /  APC does not guarantee favorable peer review; /  APC does not exempt authors from revision requirements; /  APC does not exempt authors from publication ethics, originality, data integrity, authorship, or copyright requirements; /  APC does not cover optional third-party services independently arranged by authors; /  APC does not cover bank charges imposed separately by the payer’s bank or intermediary banks unless stated in the invoice. /  APC 不等于购买录用、快速发表、正面审稿意见或特殊处理。所有稿件仍须符合 JLPCS 的期刊范围、学术质量、同行评议、研究诚信和出版伦理要求。 /  9. Open Access License / 开放获取许可 /  Articles published in JLPCS are distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0) , unless otherwise stated. /  Authors retain copyright of their published

use, distribution, reproduction, adaptation, and commercial or non-commercial use are permitted under CC BY 4.0; /  Appropriate credit must be given to the original author(s), article title, journal, source, and license. /  JLPCS 文章采用 CC BY 4.0 许可开放发布。作者保留版权，读者和使用者可在正确署名的前提下阅读、下载、复制、传播、改编和再利用文章内容。 /  10. APC and Publication Ethics / APC 与出版伦理 /  The open access publishing model does not reduce JLPCS’s ethical requirements. All submissions remain subject to journal scope assessment, editorial screening, plagiarism and similarity checks, double-blind peer review where applicable, research integrity assessment, and publication ethics requirements. /  APC payment does not override plagiarism or similarity screening; /  APC payment does not override peer review; /  APC payment does not override ethics approval, informed consent, data protection, or authorship requirements; /  APC payment does not prevent correction, expression of concern, retraction, or editorial notice when required; /  APC payment does not prevent investigation of research integrity concerns before or after publication. /  开放获取和 APC 收费不降低 JLPCS 的出版伦理要求。即使 APC 已支付，如发现抄袭、数据伪造、伦理违规、署名问题、同行评议异常或其他研究诚信问题，编辑部仍可采取相应措施。 /  11.  APC & Waiver Policy
 Article Processing Charges (APC), Administrative Service Fees, and Waiver Policy 
 1. Article Processing Charges (APC)
 Health Nexus is a fully open-access, peer-reviewed journal published by Panorama Scholarly Group (PSG). To support editorial management, peer review, production, and global dissemination, an Article Processing Charge (APC) is applied to accepted manuscripts.
 APC Amount: USD 1,500 per accepted article
 Effective Date: Applies to manuscripts accepted from 2027 onward
 Submission Fee: None
 The APC is charged only after peer review and formal acceptance. No fees are required at submission or during the review process. 
 2. Payment Methods
 Authors may complete APC payments using the following methods:
 Bank Transfer (Wire Transfer)
 Online Payment (secure electronic payment systems)
 Detailed payment instructions will be provided upon acceptance.
 3. Invoicing
 An official invoice is generated and sent to the corresponding author via email upon manuscript acceptance.
 The invoice will include: 
 APC amount
 Payment instructions
 Transaction reference details
 Authors are responsible for ensuring the accuracy of billing information at submission. 
 4. Payment Confirmation and Receipts
 Authors must complete payment according to the invoice instructions.
 A payment confirmation and/or receipt will be issued after verification.
 Authors may contact the Editorial Office for billing support if needed.
 5. Publication and Article Delivery
 After payment and final production:
 The final published article, or Version of Record, will be: 
 Published on the journal’s official website
 Assigned a Digital Object Identifier (DOI)
 The corresponding author will receive: 
 Email notification upon publication
 A direct link to access the published article
 This ensures compliance with international standards for permanent accessibility and citation. 
 6. Waiver and Discount Policy
 Health Nexus is committed to equitable access to publication and offers APC waivers or discounts.
 6.1 Full Waivers
 May be granted to:
 Authors from low-income countries, based on internationally recognized classifications such as World Bank income groups
 Authors with demonstrated financial hardship
 6.2 Partial Waivers / Discounts
 May be granted to:
 Authors from lower-middle-income countries
 Early-career researchers without funding
 Submissions of exceptional academic merit recommended by editors
 7. Waiver Application Process
 Waiver requests must be submitted at the time of manuscript submission.
 Requests should include a brief justification.
 All applications are reviewed confidentially by the Editorial Office.
 8. Administrative Service Fees
 In addition to the Article Processing Charge (APC), Health Nexus may charge an administrative service fee for specific author-requested services that require additional editorial office, production, billing, or metadata processing after acceptance or publication.
 Administrative Service Fee: USD 100 per approved administrative request
 Applicable Stage: Post-acceptance or post-publication author-requested administrative services
 Request Time Limit: Author-requested administrative changes should normally be submitted within 30 calendar days after publication
 Submission Fee: None
 Peer-review Fee: None
 The administrative service fee may apply to the following author-requested services:
 Assessment and processing of author-requested post-publication metadata changes;
 Approved post-publication corrections to author affiliations, author information, acknowledgments, funding information, or other article metadata;
 Updates to article metadata, PDF, HTML, DOI/Crossref records, or indexing-related records following an approved correction;
 Reissuance or revision of invoices, receipts, publication certificates, or acceptance letters at the author’s request;
 Additional administrative documentation requested after acceptance or publication.
 Time limit for author-requested administrative changes: 
 Author-requested administrative changes after publication, including non-substantive changes to affiliations, author information, acknowledgments, funding details, or other metadata, should normally be submitted within 30 calendar days from the date of publication. Requests submitted more than 30 calendar days after publication will generally not be approved, unless the Editorial Office determines that the change is necessary to correct an error introduced by the journal, publisher, editorial office, or production office, or to maintain the accuracy, transparency, and integrity of the scholarly record.
 No administrative service fee will be charged for:
 Errors introduced by the journal, publisher, editorial office, or production office;
 Corrections required to maintain the accuracy and integrity of the scholarly record;
 Research integrity investigations, retractions, expressions of concern, or ethical inquiries;
 Submission, editorial assessment, peer review, or editorial decision-making;
 Complaints and appeals.
 The administrative service fee, where applicable, will be clearly communicated to authors before the service is performed. Payment of an administrative service fee does not influence editorial decisions, correction decisions, peer review, or publication ethics assessments. The Editorial Office reserves the right to decline author-requested administrative changes that are submitted outside the stated time limit or that do not constitute factual errors in the published record. 
 9. Editorial Independence
 Editorial decisions are made independently of APC payments, administrative service fees, or waiver status.
 The ability to pay does not influence acceptance.
 Waiver requests are not disclosed to reviewers.
 Payment of an administrative service fee does not influence correction decisions, editorial assessments, peer review, or publication ethics assessments.
 10. Refund Policy
 APC payments are non-refundable once an article has been accepted and processed for publication. 
 Exceptions may be considered in cases of:
 Administrative error
 Duplicate payment
 Requests must be submitted to the Editorial Office with supporting documentation.
 11. Transparency and Compliance
 This policy complies with:
 DOAJ transparency and best practice standards
 COPE principles on publication ethics
 International norms for open-access publishing
 All APC-related information and applicable administrative service fees are clearly displayed on the journal website. Authors will be informed of any applicable fee before the relevant service is performed. No fee is charged for manuscript submission, editorial assessment, or peer review.
 12. Contact for Billing and Payment
 For questions related to APCs, administrative service fees, invoices, or payments, please contact:
 Email: [email protected] 
 Publisher: Panorama Scholarly Group (PSG)

 Article Processing Charge
 PoliEcoM Administration Review is a peer-reviewed, open-access journal. To support editorial administration, peer review coordination, manuscript processing, online publication, long-term accessibility, journal operations, and open scholarly dissemination, the journal applies transparent publication and post-publication administrative processing charges.
 All charges are stated clearly below. Payment of any charge does not guarantee acceptance, does not influence editorial decisions, and does not affect the independence of the peer review process.
 1. Fee Schedule
 Article Processing Charge
 USD 350
 Charged only after formal acceptance of eligible manuscripts for publication.
 APC-Exempt Article Types
 No APC
 Book Reviews, Commentaries and Perspectives, and Critical Reviews are exempt from the Article Processing Charge.
 DOI Assignment for APC-Exempt Content
 Zenodo DOI
 Book Reviews, Commentaries and Perspectives, and Critical Reviews are exempt from APC payment and may receive a DOI through Zenodo or other open scholarly repository infrastructure.
 Post-Publication Administrative Processing Fee
 USD 100
 Charged only after publication when author-requested administrative changes, metadata updates, certification requests, or non-editorial post-publication corrections require additional processing by the Editorial Office.
 2. Payment Timing
 Article Processing Charge: The article processing charge of USD 350 is payable only after an eligible manuscript has been formally accepted for publication. No APC is charged for manuscripts rejected during editorial screening or peer review.
 APC-Exempt Article Types: Book Reviews, Commentaries and Perspectives, and Critical Reviews are exempt from the Article Processing Charge. These article types may be published as journal content and may receive DOI assignment through Zenodo or other open scholarly repository infrastructure.
 Post-Publication Administrative Processing Fee: The post-publication administrative processing fee of USD 100 is payable only after the article has been published and only when an author requests additional post-publication administrative handling, such as metadata correction, author information update, publication certificate processing, formatting-related adjustment, or other non-editorial administrative services.
 3. Multi-Currency Payment Support
 The official fee schedule of PoliEcoM Administration Review is denominated in United States dollars. To support international authors, the journal may accept payment in multiple currencies through approved payment channels, subject to invoice availability, payment platform support, banking rules, and currency conversion conditions.
 Base Currency
 All official charges are calculated with reference to USD.
 Supported Currencies
 Authors may request payment in supported currencies, such as USD, CNY/RMB, EUR, GBP, HKD, SGD, or other currencies available through the approved payment channel.
 Currency Conversion
 Currency conversion may be based on the invoice date, payment date, payment provider rate, bank rate, or other applicable exchange-rate mechanism.
 Banking and Platform Fees
 Any bank charges, transfer fees, currency conversion fees, payment platform fees, or local taxes are normally the responsibility of the payer unless otherwise agreed in writing.
 Payment confirmation: Authors should follow the invoice instructions issued by the Editorial Office or the authorized payment administrator. The final payable amount in a non-USD currency may vary according to exchange rates and payment processing conditions.
 Invoice currency: The Editorial Office may issue invoices in USD or in an equivalent supported currency where available. Authors who require a specific currency should contact the Editorial Office before making payment.
 4. No Charge for Peer Review Revisions
 Revisions requested during editorial screening, peer review, copyediting, or pre-publication production are part of the normal editorial process and are not subject to the post-publication administrative processing fee. The fee applies only to eligible author-requested administrative changes after publication.
 5. Post-Publication Changes and Corrections
 Authors may request post-publication changes only when the requested change is necessary, accurate, and ethically appropriate. All post-publication changes are subject to editorial review and approval. The journal does not permit undisclosed or improper changes to the scholarly record.
 Minor corrections caused by journal production or Editorial Office errors will be corrected without charge.
 Author-requested administrative corrections after publication may be subject to the USD 100 post-publication administrative processing fee, or its equivalent in a supported currency.
 Requests involving author name changes, affiliation updates, metadata revisions, publication certificate processing, or non-editorial formatting adjustments may require administrative review.
 Substantive changes affecting data, analysis, findings, conclusions, authorship, funding disclosure, conflicts of interest, or research ethics must be reviewed by the Editorial Office and may require a formal correction notice.
 Corrections, expressions of concern, or retractions will be handled according to the journal’s publication ethics and correction policies.
 6. Estimated Editorial and Publication Timeline
 The journal seeks to provide an efficient and rigorous editorial process. The following timeline is an estimate and may vary depending on manuscript quality, reviewer availability, revision complexity, ethical checks, and editorial workload.
 Technical Completeness Check
 Normally 3–5 business days after submission
 Initial Editorial Screening
 Normally 7–10 business days after technical clearance
 Double-Blind Peer Review
 Normally 4–8 weeks
 Author Revision Period
 Normally 2–4 weeks, depending on the editorial decision
 Final Editorial Decision
 Normally 5–10 business days after revised submission
 Online Publication after Acceptance
 Normally 10–20 business days after final files and APC payment are completed
 Estimated time to first editorial decision: approximately 6–10 weeks for manuscripts sent to external peer review.
 Estimated time from submission to online publication: approximately 12–16 weeks for manuscripts accepted after peer review and revision.
 7. APC Exemption and DOI Policy
 Book Reviews, Commentaries and Perspectives, and Critical Reviews are exempt from the Article Processing Charge. These article types are handled as scholarly or editorial content within the journal and may receive DOI assignment through Zenodo or other open scholarly repository infrastructure.
 For APC-exempt content, DOI assignment may differ from the journal’s standard DOI registration workflow. Where applicable, a Zenodo DOI or equivalent open repository DOI may be used to support discoverability, citation, archiving, and long-term access.
 Book Reviews: no APC; DOI may be assigned through Zenodo or equivalent open repository infrastructure.

 Article Processing Charges (APCs)
 JESA is an open-access journal. To support editorial, production, hosting, and preservation services, an article processing charge may be requested after a manuscript is accepted.
 Current charges
 USD 400: research articles, review articles, case studies and applications, and interdisciplinary insights.
 USD 200: brief reports and short communications.
 Waivers and discounts
 Waivers or discounts may be considered for authors from low- and middle-income countries, early-career researchers, or authors experiencing documented financial hardship. Requests should be made as early as possible and do not influence editorial or peer-review decisions.
 Payment and invoicing
 There is no submission fee.
 An invoice is issued after acceptance, not at the time of submission.
 Payment instructions and the applicable amount are confirmed by the editorial office.
 Questions about charges or a waiver request may be sent through the Contact page.

 Article Processing Charge (APC)
 Three Teachings Studies: Confucianism, Daoism, and Buddhism (TTS) is a peer-reviewed, open-access academic journal. To sustain editorial operations, peer review, and digital infrastructure, TTS charges a modest Article Processing Charge (APC) for accepted research articles.
 APC Amount
 The standard APC for accepted articles is: 
 $350 USD 
 This charge applies only after peer review and formal acceptance . It covers:
 ✓ Full open-access publication (no paywalls)
 ✓ DOI registration and indexing
 ✓ Editorial coordination and professional layout
 ✓ Server hosting and long-term archiving
 Note: TTS does not charge submission fees .
 Book reviews, forum essays, and other invited contributions are free of charge. 
 Waivers and Reductions
 TTS supports inclusive publishing. We offer partial or full APC waivers in the following cases:
 ▪ Authors without institutional or grant funding
 ▪ Early-career researchers or graduate students
 ▪ Authors from low- or middle-income countries (as per World Bank classification)
 Waiver requests should be submitted after acceptance and must include a brief explanation. Decisions are made confidentially and on a case-by-case basis.
 For APC-related questions or waiver inquiries, please contact the editorial team at:
 [email protected]

 2026 APC Discount 
 2026 APC Discount
 Posted on 2026-04-14 11:42:15
 Three Teachings Studies: Confucianism, Daoism, and Buddhism (TTS) is pleased to announce a preferential Article Processing Charge (APC) for manuscripts submitted in 2026 .
 For all manuscripts submitted during the 2026 calendar year and subsequently accepted for publication following peer review, the APC will be set at USD 120 .
 This arrangement is intended to support the journal’s open-access publishing mission and to encourage high-quality submissions in the fields of Confucianism, Daoism, Buddhism , as well as related comparative and cross-cultural studies in East Asian thought.
 TTS welcomes submissions in English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese . In accordance with journal policy, non-English manuscripts must be accompanied by an English title and abstract .
 Authors are kindly advised to consult the journal website for detailed information regarding submission requirements, editorial policies, and APC payment procedures.
 We warmly welcome contributions from scholars worldwide.
 《 Three Teachings Studies: Confucianism, Daoism, and Buddhism 》（TTS）特此公告：凡於 2026 年 提交之稿件，如經同儕審查後獲正式錄用，其 文章處理費 （ Article Processing Charge, APC ）優惠定為 120 美元 。
 本項安排旨在支持本刊之開放取用出版宗旨，並鼓勵儒學、道教、佛教研究，以及與東亞思想相關之比較研究與跨文化研究之優質學術成果投稿。
 本刊接受 英文、中文、日文、韓文與越南文 稿件。依本刊規定，凡非英文稿件，均須附具 英文標題與摘要 。
 有關投稿規範、編輯政策及 APC 付款方式等詳情，敬請參閱期刊官方網站相關說明。
 本刊誠摯歡迎海內外學者踴躍賜稿。

 Note: There is no submission fee . APCs are payable only after acceptance following peer review. 
 Waiver and Discount Policy
 RGGD is committed to equitable access to scholarly publishing. The following discounts and waivers apply:
 Full waivers for authors from low-income countries.
 50% discount for authors from lower-middle-income countries.
 Editorially-approved waivers for selected special issue contributors.
 All waiver requests are confidential and have no influence on editorial or peer review decisions. 
 Payment and Invoicing
 Invoices are issued only after manuscript acceptance.
 Payments can be made via bank transfer or secure online platforms .
 APC payment does not affect editorial decisions or publication scheduling.
 Funding and Support
 Authors are encouraged to seek APC support through:
 Institutional Open Access Funds.
 National or international research grants (e.g., NSFC, Horizon Europe, IDRC).
 Institutional agreements with RGGD.
 Ethics and Transparency
 RGGD follows COPE and DOAJ best practices, ensuring:
 Separation between financial processes and editorial decisions.
 Clear and upfront APC policy communication.
 Commitment to fair, ethical, and inclusive publishing.

 APC & Waiver Policy
 To support high-quality open access publishing, CSGS applies a transparent Article Processing Charge (APC) model focused on sustainability and global equity.
 Article Processing Charge
 USD 500
 Applied only to accepted manuscripts. There are:
 NO Submission Fees
 NO Review Fees
 NO Hidden Charges
 What the APC Covers
 The APC ensures your research meets the highest publication standards through:
 • Editorial Management
 • Professional Copyediting
 • DOI Registration
 • Digital Archiving
 • Global Indexing
 • CC BY 4.0 Hosting
 Editorial Independence
 Decisions are made solely on academic merit . The peer review process is completed before any payment is requested. Authors' ability to pay does not influence the acceptance or rejection of manuscripts.
 Waiver and Discount Policy
 CSGS promotes equitable global participation. Waivers are granted based on the following criteria:
 1. Low-Income Countries 
 Authors from World Bank-classified low-income economies are eligible for a Full Waiver (100%) .
 2. Lower-Middle-Income 
 Authors from lower-middle-income economies are eligible for a Partial Waiver (up to 50%) .
 3. Financial Hardship 
 Individual waiver requests are considered for authors without institutional funding or those in special circumstances.
 4. Special Editorial Initiatives
 Waivers may be offered for invited keynote contributions, special issue initiatives, and Global South climate research programs. All waiver requests must be submitted at the time of manuscript submission.

 The APC amount (USD 500) is fixed and clearly displayed. No hidden fees apply. Any future adjustments to APC rates will be publicly announced at least six months in advance.

 APC & Waiver Policy
 Journal of Social Cognition and Communication operates under an open access publishing model. To support editorial management, peer review, production, and digital publication services, an Article Processing Charge (APC) may apply to accepted manuscripts.
 The journal is committed to transparent publishing practices. All publication fees are clearly stated and are independent of the editorial decision-making process. Manuscripts are evaluated solely on the basis of academic merit, originality, and relevance to the journal’s scope.
 Article Processing Charges apply only after a manuscript has been formally accepted for publication.
 1. Article Processing Charge (APC)
 For standard research submissions, the Article Processing Charge (APC) is:
 USD 600 per accepted article
 The APC covers the cost of editorial handling, double-anonymous peer review management, copyediting, typesetting, metadata preparation, online publication, and long-term digital preservation.
 2. Articles Exempt from APC
 Certain categories of contributions are published free of charge in order to encourage academic discussion and scholarly engagement. These include:
 Book Reviews 
 Short Communications 
 No publication fee is required for these article types.
 3. Waiver and Reduction Policy
 The journal recognizes that authors from certain regions or institutions may have limited access to research funding. In appropriate cases, partial waivers or reductions of the APC may be considered.
 Authors who require financial assistance may submit a waiver request to the editorial office after acceptance of their manuscript. Requests are evaluated on a case-by-case basis and may consider factors such as institutional funding availability and the author’s circumstances.
 4. Editorial Independence
 The payment of an APC does not influence editorial decisions. All manuscripts are evaluated solely on the basis of scholarly merit, relevance to the journal’s scope, and the results of the peer review process.
 Editors and reviewers do not have access to information regarding APC payments during the evaluation process.
 The journal supports transparent and responsible open access publishing practices while promoting equitable access to scholarly communication.

 Call for Papers: JSCC Vol. 1 No. 2 October Issue — APC Waiver for Accepted Manuscripts 
 Call for Papers: JSCC Vol. 1 No. 2 October Issue — APC Waiver for Accepted Manuscripts
 Posted on 2026-05-04 05:57:01
 Journal of Social Cognition and Communication is pleased to announce the Call for Papers for Vol. 1 No. 2, the October Issue.
 This issue welcomes original and interdisciplinary research on social cognition, communication, media, culture, technology, and public life. We invite submissions that examine how individuals, groups, institutions, media environments, and technological systems shape perception, judgment, emotion, trust, identity formation, meaning-making, and communicative practices in contemporary society.
 Topics of interest include, but are not limited to:
 • Social cognition and communication psychology
• Digital media, platform communication, and audience cognition
• AI-mediated communication, algorithmic influence, and human–technology interaction
• Misinformation, media trust, and information credibility
• Public opinion, political communication, and collective cognition
• Cross-cultural communication, cultural cognition, and social meaning
• Communication ethics, technological society, and public life
• Theoretical, methodological, and conceptual innovation in social cognition and communication research
 The journal welcomes original research articles, theoretical papers, review articles, methodological studies, short communications, and academic book reviews. Submissions from communication studies, social psychology, media studies, sociology, cultural studies, political communication, digital society studies, and related interdisciplinary fields are especially encouraged.
 All submissions will undergo double-blind peer review and will be evaluated according to academic quality, originality, methodological rigor, ethical compliance, and relevance to the journal’s scope.
 Special Notice on APC Waiver
 For Vol. 1 No. 2, the October Issue, all accepted manuscripts will be published without Article Processing Charges (APCs). This temporary APC waiver applies only to this issue and does not affect the journal’s editorial independence, peer-review standards, or academic quality requirements.
 Authors are invited to submit their manuscripts through the journal’s online submission system.

 Article Processing Charges (APC) Information
 The Journal of Modern Social Sciences (JMSS) Publication Charges
 The Journal of Modern Social Sciences is a fully open-access journal, grounded in the belief that academic research should be freely accessible to all, without financial barriers. Each article published is immediately available to a global audience, without the need for subscriptions or access fees. To maintain our rigorous editorial standards and ensure the long-term sustainability of the journal, JMSS has adopted the following fee structure:
 Article Processing Charge (APCs)
 Upon acceptance of your manuscript for publication, an Article Processing Charge (APC) will be required. The standard APC is as follows, effective July 1, 2025:
 400 USD 
 513 SGD 
 342 EUR 
 296 GBP 
 554 CAD 
 2880 CNY 
 In addition, after receiving the invoice, authors may contact the editorial office to have a new invoice issued based on their preferred currency. The Asia Technology Research Institute (ATRI) has accounts in Singapore, the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, the European Union, and mainland China.
 The listed prices do not include taxes, which will be applied to the final amount. This fee supports a complete, high-quality publishing workflow, from professional editing and meticulous typesetting to seamless digital publication. It also funds the continuous development and maintenance of the JMSS platform, ensuring your research remains permanently and reliably available through open access..
 In addition, the APC contributes to various initiatives aimed at enhancing the visibility and impact of the research we publish. These include indexing in leading academic databases and integrating advanced digital tools, which enhance the discoverability of JMSS articles and ensure that they are accessible and citable across a broad range of international scholarly platforms. 
 Low and Lower-Middle Income Country Open Access Discount Program 
 We offer fee waivers to scholars from African countries and developing countries around the world. This waiver is provided by the Asia Technology Research Institute (ATRI) to promote high-quality, peer-reviewed scholarly publishing in developing countries. In fact, ATRI sometimes offers 100% fee waivers to scholars from developing countries, depending on the circumstances. 
 Student Discount and Fee Waiver
 To support students facing financial challenges, we offer a student discount or fee waiver program. Students who meet the following criteria can apply:
 The student must provide valid proof of enrollment.
 The article must meet the publication's basic criteria.
 If eligible, students will receive a discount or fee reduction based on the quality of their article and their specific circumstances. Please contact us for more details about the application process.
 With ATRI's affiliated journals, the last thing you need to worry about is publication fees. For outstanding articles, we will proactively apply for fee waivers on your behalf. All you need to do is prepare an excellent manuscript, and we will ensure it is well supported throughout the process.
 Contact Us
 For further information regarding our publication fees or to inquire about possible fee waivers, please feel free to contact the JMSS editorial office at:
 Email: [email protected] 
 We are committed to transparency and are here to assist our authors throughout the publication process.

 General Information on ATRI’s Article Processing Charges (APC)
 General Information on ATRI’s Article Processing Charges (APC)
 ATRI publishes all its journals in full open access, meaning unlimited use and reuse of articles, in addition to giving credit to the authors. All of our articles are published under a Creative Commons (CC BY) license.
 Authors pay a one-time Article Processing Charge (APC) to cover the costs of peer review administration and management, professional production of articles in PDF and other formats, and dissemination of published papers in various venues, in addition to other publishing functions. Please note that the option to process an advance payment remains but does not guarantee acceptance of manuscripts. There are no charges for rejected articles, no submission charges, and no surcharges based on the length of an article, figures or supplementary data. Some items (Editorials, Corrections, Addendums, Retractions, Comments, etc.) are published free of charge.
 Submitted papers should be well-prepared, with good English and clear figures. Authors should resolve issues prior to publication, e.g., in response to reviewer feedback, or risk delays and even rejection. ATRI Author Services offers professional English and Figure Editing.
 Optional Premium Services
 ATRI offers a suite of optional, value-added services designed to assist authors with manuscript finalization and post-acceptance workflow management. These services are provided by our specialized Author Services division. It is paramount to understand that the utilization of any premium service is entirely voluntary and is separated from the peer-review and editorial decision-making process. Editorial acceptance of a manuscript is based exclusively on its scholarly quality, scientific rigor, and adherence to ethical guidelines. 
 Accelerated Publication Service (APS) : $400 USD 
 This service streamlines the technical steps in the production pipeline after a manuscript has been formally accepted by the Academic Editor. It specifically targets expediting copyediting, professional typesetting, proof generation, and final online posting. Authors selecting APS can expect a significantly reduced time-to-publication once the final version of the manuscript is submitted.
 Journal-Specific Formatting Service (JFS) : $150 USD 
 JFS is offered for authors who require professional assistance in ensuring their final accepted manuscript strictly adheres to the target journal’s specific style guide, citation format, and layout requirements (e.g., heading levels, reference list layout, figure caption presentation). This option is designed to minimize potential delays caused by post-acceptance formatting discrepancies.
 1. Publishing Operations & Projects
 ATRI develops and maintains its own electronic submission and peer-review website. We also run several platforms to offer different types of services for scholars, as detailed in our ATRI Initiatives page.
 2. Journal Publication
 Triaging : Filtering of papers upon submission by internal staff and editorial board members.
 Organization of peer-review : ATRI provides a high degree of assistance to Academic Editors so that they can focus on editorial decisions. We employ in-house editors to invite reviewers, collect review reports, communicate with authors and reviewers, correspond with authors about revisions, and more.
 Production : Copy-editing, typesetting, XML and PDF conversion, and minor language editing.
 Language and Figures : The APC includes minor English editing only and no figure editing. Authors may choose to pay for ATRI Author Services’ premium manuscript preparation services.
 Proofreading : Corresponding with authors to approve the final text and requesting any missing information.
 Other editorial assistance : Handling any questions and requests for support before submission, during the editorial and peer-review process, or post-publication.
 Journal management & development : In-house Managing Editors track key performance indicators of each journal, and monitor competing journals and trends in the field. They also provide reports and hold discussions with the Editor-in-Chief and the Editorial Board.
 Indexing & archiving : ATRI has a dedicated team that works to continuously expand post-publication coverage of all our journals within the main academic databases, scope-specific databases, and country-specific journal ranking lists.
 Digital preservation : All ATRI journals are digitally preserved cover-to-cover, by the Swiss National Library and CLOCKSS, ensuring long-term archival of all of our publications.
 3. Editorial Fees
 ATRI pays a travel grant or stipend to all Editors-in-Chief. For the societies whose journals ATRI publishes, the company provides a share of the revenue to the society.
 4. Marketing and Communication 
 ATRI allocates part of its income to the promotion of journals and articles through sponsorships of conferences, scholarly society events, and other promotional activities, as well as a series of awards to support researchers.
 5. General
 Management & administration includes costs related to salaries of non-editorial staff and other business costs. They include all the fees paid by ATRI for membership in publishing organizations, such as the STM Association, OASPA, and the Society for Scholarly Publishing (SSP), as well as additional publishing services such as Publons. Most membership fees are based on the level of income or size of the publisher.
 Taxes .
 ATRI supports the activities of the ATRI Sustainability Foundation, including coordinating the World Sustainability Forum and World Sustainability Awards. ATRI is a debt-free company and is not repaying loans or investments.
 6. Discounts and Waivers
 ATRI is committed to supporting the transition of all research to fully open access, therefore we regularly offer APC waivers or discounts. On average, we waive approximately 25% - 27% of our content every year. Of the total APCs in a journal, we waive and offer discounts ranging from 15% in our most established journals, up to 100% in our new or humanities journals. In many social sciences and humanities journals we waive between 70% - 100% of APCs (an APC is still displayed on these journal's websites, in order to demonstrate to authors that there is a cost to publication). Even some of our well-established journals waive 30% of publishing costs each year.
 Additionally, members of societies affiliated with an ATRI journal benefit from a discount, as well as authors affiliated with institutions participating in our Institutional Open Access Program.
 For journals in fields with low levels of funding, where authors typically do not have funds available, APCs are typically waived and cross-subsidized from fields for which more APC funding is available. For authors from low- and middle-income countries, waivers or discounts may be granted on a case-by-case basis. Applications submitted before article submission are assessed by the Managing Editor based on the quality of the research article and the authors’ ability to pay.

 General Information on ATRI’s Article Processing Charges (APC)
 General Information on ATRI’s Article Processing Charges (APC)
 ATRI publishes all its journals in full open access, meaning unlimited use and reuse of articles, in addition to giving credit to the authors. All of our articles are published under a Creative Commons (CC BY) license.
 Authors pay a one-time Article Processing Charge (APC) to cover the costs of peer review administration and management, professional production of articles in PDF and other formats, and dissemination of published papers in various venues, in addition to other publishing functions. Please note that the option to process an advance payment remains but does not guarantee acceptance of manuscripts. There are no charges for rejected articles, no submission charges, and no surcharges based on the length of an article, figures or supplementary data. Some items (Editorials, Corrections, Addendums, Retractions, Comments, etc.) are published free of charge.
 Submitted papers should be well-prepared, with good English and clear figures. Authors should resolve issues prior to publication, e.g., in response to reviewer feedback, or risk delays and even rejection. ATRI Author Services offers professional English and Figure Editing.
 Optional Premium Services
 ATRI offers a suite of optional, value-added services designed to assist authors with manuscript finalization and post-acceptance workflow management. These services are provided by our specialized Author Services division. It is paramount to understand that the utilization of any premium service is entirely voluntary and is separated from the peer-review and editorial decision-making process. Editorial acceptance of a manuscript is based exclusively on its scholarly quality, scientific rigor, and adherence to ethical guidelines. 
 Accelerated Publication Service (APS) : $400 USD 
 This service streamlines the technical steps in the production pipeline after a manuscript has been formally accepted by the Academic Editor. It specifically targets expediting copyediting, professional typesetting, proof generation, and final online posting. Authors selecting APS can expect a significantly reduced time-to-publication once the final version of the manuscript is submitted.
 Journal-Specific Formatting Service (JFS) : $150 USD 
 JFS is offered for authors who require professional assistance in ensuring their final accepted manuscript strictly adheres to the target journal’s specific style guide, citation format, and layout requirements (e.g., heading levels, reference list layout, figure caption presentation). This option is designed to minimize potential delays caused by post-acceptance formatting discrepancies.
 1. Publishing Operations & Projects
 ATRI develops and maintains its own electronic submission and peer-review website. We also run several platforms to offer different types of services for scholars, as detailed in our ATRI Initiatives page.
 2. Journal Publication
 Triaging : Filtering of papers upon submission by internal staff and editorial board members.
 Organization of peer-review : ATRI provides a high degree of assistance to Academic Editors so that they can focus on editorial decisions. We employ in-house editors to invite reviewers, collect review reports, communicate with authors and reviewers, correspond with authors about revisions, and more.
 Production : Copy-editing, typesetting, XML and PDF conversion, and minor language editing.
 Language and Figures : The APC includes minor English editing only and no figure editing. Authors may choose to pay for ATRI Author Services’ premium manuscript preparation services.
 Proofreading : Corresponding with authors to approve the final text and requesting any missing information.
 Other editorial assistance : Handling any questions and requests for support before submission, during the editorial and peer-review process, or post-publication.
 Journal management & development : In-house Managing Editors track key performance indicators of each journal, and monitor competing journals and trends in the field. They also provide reports and hold discussions with the Editor-in-Chief and the Editorial Board.
 Indexing & archiving : ATRI has a dedicated team that works to continuously expand post-publication coverage of all our journals within the main academic databases, scope-specific databases, and country-specific journal ranking lists.
 Digital preservation : All ATRI journals are digitally preserved cover-to-cover, by the Swiss National Library and CLOCKSS, ensuring long-term archival of all of our publications.
 3. Editorial Fees
 ATRI pays a travel grant or stipend to all Editors-in-Chief. For the societies whose journals ATRI publishes, the company provides a share of the revenue to the society.
 4. Marketing and Communication 
 ATRI allocates part of its income to the promotion of journals and articles through sponsorships of conferences, scholarly society events, and other promotional activities, as well as a series of awards to support researchers.
 5. General
 Management & administration includes costs related to salaries of non-editorial staff and other business costs. They include all the fees paid by ATRI for membership in publishing organizations, such as the STM Association, OASPA, and the Society for Scholarly Publishing (SSP), as well as additional publishing services such as Publons. Most membership fees are based on the level of income or size of the publisher.
 Taxes .
 ATRI supports the activities of the ATRI Sustainability Foundation, including coordinating the World Sustainability Forum and World Sustainability Awards. ATRI is a debt-free company and is not repaying loans or investments.
 6. Discounts and Waivers
 ATRI is committed to supporting the transition of all research to fully open access, therefore we regularly offer APC waivers or discounts. On average, we waive approximately 25% - 27% of our content every year. Of the total APCs in a journal, we waive and offer discounts ranging from 15% in our most established journals, up to 100% in our new or humanities journals. In many social sciences and humanities journals we waive between 70% - 100% of APCs (an APC is still displayed on these journal's websites, in order to demonstrate to authors that there is a cost to publication). Even some of our well-established journals waive 30% of publishing costs each year.
 Additionally, members of societies affiliated with an ATRI journal benefit from a discount, as well as authors affiliated with institutions participating in our Institutional Open Access Program.
 For journals in fields with low levels of funding, where authors typically do not have funds available, APCs are typically waived and cross-subsidized from fields for which more APC funding is available. For authors from low- and middle-income countries, waivers or discounts may be granted on a case-by-case basis. Applications submitted before article submission are assessed by the Managing Editor based on the quality of the research article and the authors’ ability to pay.
